import fs from 'node:fs';import path from 'node:path';import {fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';import {SQLiteContextEngine} from '../src/engine/engine.js';const __dirname=path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..");const SRC=path.join(__dirname,'mcp_memory.sqlite');const TMP=path.join(__dirname,'stress_temp.sqlite');fs.copyFileSync(SRC,TMP);console.log('=== RED-TEAM & STRESS-TEST SUITE ===');const m0=process.memoryUsage().heapUsed,t0=performance.now();const eng=new SQLiteContextEngine(TMP);const boot=(performance.now()-t0).toFixed(1),ram=((process.memoryUsage().heapUsed-m0)/1048576).toFixed(1);console.log('
[TEST 1: COLD-START & RAM]
  Boot:',boot,'ms | Heap:',ram,'MB | 1M rows proj:',((ram/eng.M_ref)*1e6).toFixed(0),'MB');const qs=['ADAR1 binds to Dicer to cleave pre-miRNA. AIRE is expressed in some skin tumors.','myeloid-derived suppressor cells MDSC expansion S100A9 CD33','CRISPR Cas9 genome editing electroporation rat zygotes','chronic lymphocytic leukemia subclonal driver mutations SF3B1 TP53'];const lats=[];for(let i=0;i<200;i++){const s=performance.now();eng.packContext(qs[i%4],{budget:200});lats.push(performance.now()-s);}lats.sort((a,b)=>a-b);console.log('
[TEST 2: 200-QUERY THROUGHPUT]
  P50:',lats[100].toFixed(2),'ms | P95:',lats[190].toFixed(2),'ms | QPS:',(1000/(lats.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/200)).toFixed(0));eng.storeMemory('CRISPR and Cas9 ribonucleoproteins enable precise homology-directed repair in human T cells.','t_doc','t_s0');const s1=eng.storeMemory(Array(15).fill('crispr cas9').join(' ')+' repair human cells','s1_doc','s1_s0');const junk='alpha bravo charlie delta echo foxtrot golf hotel india juliet kilo lima mike november oscar papa quebec romeo sierra tango uniform victor whiskey xray yankee zulu amber bronze cobalt crimson emerald ivory jade onyx topaz';const s2=eng.storeMemory(Array(5).fill('crispr cas9').join(' ')+' '+junk,'s2_doc','s2_s0');console.log('
[TEST 3: SPAM EXPLOIT]
  Clean Fact Score:',eng.scoreChunkP4('t_s0','crispr cas9 repair').toFixed(3),'
  Naive Spam (L/U='+s1.l_over_u+'):',eng.scoreChunkP4('s1_s0','crispr cas9 repair').toFixed(3),'
  Word-Salad Spam (L/U='+s2.l_over_u+'):',eng.scoreChunkP4('s2_s0','crispr cas9 repair').toFixed(3));for(let i=0;i<105;i++)eng.storeMemory('quantumentanglement2026 superconductor decoherence run '+i,'d_'+i,'ds_'+i);eng.storeMemory('Critical threshold for raretargetbeta99 stability is 4.2 Kelvin.','pb','pb_s0');const trap=eng.packContext('quantumentanglement2026 superconductor decoherence raretargetbeta99',{budget:150});console.log('
[TEST 4: FTS5 LIMIT-100 STARVATION]
  Found Part-B behind 105 Part-A decoys?:',trap.includes('pb_s0'));eng.storeMemory('Patients exhibited acute myocardial infarction following coronary occlusion.','syn','syn_s0');console.log('
[TEST 5: SYNONYM WALL]
  Query "heart attack" found "myocardial infarction"?:',eng.packContext('heart attack blocked vessel',{budget:120}).includes('syn_s0'));console.log('
[TEST 6: CODE TOKENIZER]
  "How to fix C++ segfault in .env for R?" ->',JSON.stringify(tokenize('How to fix C++ segfault in .env for R?')));const c1=eng.storeMemory('ok sounds good thanks bro','c1','c1_s0',200);const c2=eng.storeMemory('Architectural Decision: Enforce mutual TLS authentication using rotating X509 certificates and validate JWT claims at ingress gateway.','c2','c2_s0',200);console.log('
[TEST 7: TEMPORAL SURPRISAL BIAS (Age=200d)]
  5-word chat tf:',eng.temporalFactor('c1_s0').toFixed(4),'(intr='+c1.intrinsic_surprisal+')
  18-word spec tf:',eng.temporalFactor('c2_s0').toFixed(4),'(intr='+c2.intrinsic_surprisal+')');fs.unlinkSync(TMP);
